language.script_notes: English with Māori place names; this island has the highest concentration of Māori place names and marae (meeting houses) and the largest Māori population.

road_furniture.bollard_color: As national — the red band wraps fully around the white post.
road_furniture.curb_style: As national; dense motorway and suburban infrastructure around Auckland.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: As national; telephone area codes 09 to 07 cover Auckland and points north, and 06 and 04 the southern half of the island.

architecture.roof_style: Simple pitched corrugated-iron roofs as national; Art Deco buildings with flat roofs in Napier and Hastings.
architecture.wall_construction: Timber villas and bungalows on suburban lots; Art Deco town centres rebuilt after the 1931 Hawke's Bay earthquake; Māori carved meeting houses (wharenui) with steep gabled fronts and elaborate carving.
architecture.wall_color_palette: White and pastel weatherboard, with the bright reds and blacks of Māori carving.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Timber villas; Art Deco streets in Napier; carved Māori meeting houses; geothermal-area spa towns like Rotorua; Auckland's high-rise skyline and harbour bridge.

nature.vegetation: Lush rolling pasture, pōhutukawa trees on northern coasts, tall tree ferns and subtropical bush in the north, giant reeds along some Auckland-area shores, and windbreak forests in the Bay of Plenty.
nature.terrain: A volcanic island — Auckland sits on a field of small volcanic cones, and the central plateau has the caldera lakes of Taupō and Rotorua and the snow-capped volcanoes Tongariro, Ngauruhoe and Ruapehu; Mount Taranaki's symmetrical cone rises alone on the west coast; a central spine of ranges is flanked by rolling farmland.
nature.climate_signature: Warmer and more humid than the south, with subtropical greenery in the far north and geothermal steam around Rotorua.

vehicles.distinctive_vehicles: Heavier city traffic in Auckland; ute pickups and farm vehicles in the countryside.

google_coverage.camera_generation: A mix of Gen 3 and Gen 4.
google_coverage.coverage_notes: Dense coverage around Auckland, Wellington and the main highways; some gravel back roads in the north are covered.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Left-hand traffic, English signage, similar suburbs
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Volcanic cones and geothermal steam, tree ferns, the fully wrapped red bollard band, red give-way text and possum-guard poles differ from Australia.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same country, same national road furniture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The North has volcanoes, subtropical greenery and rolling farmland; the South has the Southern Alps, the Canterbury Plains and the fiords.
